title: What Counts as the Same Task? Executable Contracts for Robustness Evaluation of Tool-Using Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.14477v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robustness tests for tool-using agents often change the agent's environment, for example by hiding a hostile note in an invoice, and then judge the agent by what it does. The result tells us about the original task only if the changed test case is still a valid test of that task. Many evaluations decide this with weak rules, such as accepting any well-formed edit or any edit that stays close to the original in embedding space. We propose executable task contracts. A contract states which facts define a task, which edits are allowed, and what finishing the task means, and it checks each changed test case before the agent runs. We compare validity rules by scoring the same 14,336 stored agent runs under each rule. Across four encoders, embedding thresholds allowed 75-100% of edits that changed the task, such as swapping the payee, yet rejected 24-45% of valid hostile notes. translated_title: 什么才算同一个任务？用于工具使用智能体鲁棒性评估的可执行契约
translated_abstract: 针对工具使用智能体的鲁棒性测试通常会改变智能体的运行环境，例如在发票中隐藏一条恶意备注，然后根据智能体的行为来评判其表现。只有当修改后的测试用例仍然是该任务的有效测试时，测试结果才能反映智能体在原始任务上的表现。然而，许多评估采用宽松的规则来判定有效性，例如接受任何格式良好的编辑，或接受在嵌入空间中与原始样本足够接近的任何编辑。我们提出可执行任务契约：一份契约明确规定了哪些事实定义了一个任务、允许哪些编辑，以及完成任务意味着什么，并在智能体运行之前对每个修改后的测试用例进行检查。我们通过在每种有效性规则下对相同的14,336条已存储的智能体运行记录进行评分，来比较不同规则的效果。在四个编码器上，基于嵌入阈值的方法允许75-100%改变了任务本质的编辑通过（例如更换收款人），却拒绝了24-45%的有效恶意备注。在使用MiniLM余弦阈值时，Mistral在某个（原文截断）
tldr: 本文提出“可执行任务契约”方法，通过明确界定任务定义事实、允许的编辑范围和任务完成标准来在测试前验证修改后测试用例的有效性，实验表明基于嵌入阈值的宽松规则会放行75-100%改变任务实质的编辑（如更换收款人），同时错误拒绝24-45%的有效恶意注入测试。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes executable task contracts—which specify the facts defining a task, permitted edits, and completion criteria—to validate modified test cases before agent execution, showing that embedding-threshold rules allow 75-100% of task-altering edits (e.g., swapping the payee) while wrongly rejecting 24-45% of valid hostile notes.
